messages.subject: Data order
parts:
Hi INLA users, 


I wanted to verify that the order of locations in the INLA graph matches the order of the spatiotemporal data based on 'IDs'. I constructed a spatial graph using the 'inla.read.graph' function. I tried to extract IDs from the graph to compare with IDs in the spatiotemporal data, but it seemed not applicable. I am unsure of its possibilities, though. 


I have verified that the order of the locations matched the spatiotemporal data before constructing the INLA graph. 


Am I expected to verify the order once I construct the INLA graph before fitting the spatiotemporal model? 


Is there a special technique to verify the order of locations in the spatial dependency graph and spatiotemporal data?


Best regards, 

Regards,
